description: Change an existing workspace teammate’s role (admin, editor or viewer) on Studio or Pro. Ask the user before changing a teammate’s permissions.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

role.description: New workspace role for this teammate: "admin", "editor" or "viewer".

name: team_role_set
title: Change a teammate’s role
